## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

An eight-fascicle late-Míng commentary on the *Fànwǎng* bodhisattva-precepts by the Vinaya specialist **Hóngzàn** 弘贊 ([弘贊](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BC%98%E8%B4%8A), 1611–1685). 略疏 *lüèshū* "concise commentary" — though the eight fascicles indicate that the work is concise only by comparison with the encyclopedic Tang commentaries.

**Abstract**

Hóngzàn's commentary is one of the principal late-Míng / early-Qīng commentaries on the *Fànwǎng jīng*, alongside [智旭](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E6%97%AD) Zhìxù's *Fànwǎngjīng hézhù* ([KR6k0097](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0097)) and [寂光](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AF%82%E5%85%89) Jìguāng's *Fànwǎngjīng zhíjiě* ([KR6k0100](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0100)). Hóngzàn approached the *Fànwǎng* from a Vinaya-specialist perspective, emphasising practical procedural-disciplinary application over against the doctrinal-philosophical readings of Zhūhóng and Zhìxù. The text is preserved in the Jiāxīng 嘉興 edition of the canon — a valuable Míng-Qīng compilation independent of the standard Buddhist Tripiṭaka.
